summary: This code validates a JSON data file against a JSON schema. It loads both files, uses the jsonschema library to check that the data matches the schema rules, and prints whether validation succeeded or failed.

explanations.2: The 'with' statement opens the file and automatically closes it when done, even if something goes wrong.
explanations.3: json.load() reads the file and converts the JSON text into a Python dictionary we can work with.
explanations.8: This is the actual validation—it checks that the data structure matches all the rules defined in the schema, and raises an error if it doesn't.
explanations.16: We're catching a specific type of error that jsonschema raises when validation fails, so we can handle it gracefully instead of crashing.
